bounded_evidence_snapshots.input_policy: Every reuse hashes fixture bytes/lock, tools, function analysis, canonical sources/proofs, referenced unit files and runtime/topology evidence; additions, deletions and content edits invalidate. limitations: Host-only cached verification control, not a guest compilation or sustained fleet throughput benchmark.
Content hashing remains in every reuse; a single image read adds snapshot setup work.

candidates.name: Manx Aztec C Amiga 5.0a
candidates.version_basis: 5.0a executed cc/as/ln banners, Jan 9 1990; archive read.me instead says 01/09/89

compiler_fingerprint_matrix.game_discrimination: 82 recovered game functions match the default aztec36 profile; three independent functions require and match documented aztec36 +D large-data addressing, including ov04_F_26F0 with 25 absolute resident-global relocations and a compiler-owned CODE literal. Tested aztec50-short alternatives differ. Unique historical release remains unresolved.

aztec36-large-data.meaning: Documented 3.6a large-data memory-model mode. It makes data references position-dependent and is tested only for evidence that requires an absolute HUNK_RELOC32 data address; the normal inner-loop profile remains aztec36.

aztec36-x3.meaning: Documented 3.6-era code-generator mode that delays stack cleanup across adjacent calls; the adjacent_calls fingerprint emits one four-byte cleanup instead of two two-byte cleanups, so it is retained as an alternate rather than the default recovery profile.

wave7-graphics-002: CRLF authored assembly rejected; corrected with LF in fresh wave7-graphics-003.
limitations: Only complete CODE units are counted. The four-byte empty BSS sentinel and per-link CODE padding are control obligations, never additional claimed bytes.
No original compiler release, storage/TU ownership, resident layout or aggregate executable proof.

link_command_line_limit.cache_identity_impact: 0 of 1029 cached identities gain the new field except the shell-rejected 94cbb29bb1e6 failure. Editing compiler_oracle.py changes its file hash, which is in named-entry/proxy identities: 1 cached entry carried the prior hash (28 already carried older hashes).

experiments.observation: Aztec 3.6a ln linking 1..33 trivial independent objects: direct commands up to 548 characters (31 objects) returned 0; 563 (32) and 578 (33) returned 10 with an empty redirected log and no executable, reproducing the region failure. ln -f argument files (single-line and one-per-line) linked 7 and 33 objects; the 7-object -f executable and .sym are byte-identical to the direct link.

Same 30-object link padded with spaces to 544..571 characters: <=555 linked, >=556 returned 10. Argument text after the command name and redirections was 510 (pass) vs 511 (fail). C:Echo lines fail with 10 at the same argument length (507 ran, 511 failed), so the limit is the guest shell, not ln.
ln -f with 96 objects (1462-byte argument file) linked with status 0.

failed_attempts: Single-quoted long C:Echo lines were rejected by Echo itself above ~255 characters (Invalid argument to ECHO) and could not probe the shell limit; multi-word Echo was also rejected but still showed the shell-level status-10 boundary.
link_command_line_limit.fix: tools/link_line.py: direct form unchanged when argument text <= 480 characters; otherwise the oracle writes PREFIX-ln.lnk (one argument per line, same order) and runs ln -m -t -o PREFIX.exe -f PREFIX-ln.lnk. Only argument-file links gain identity field link_argument_file.
hypotheses_tested: Aztec ln object-count limit (rejected: 31 objects linked directly, 33 and 96 objects linked via -f)
link_command_line_limit.limit: Guest shell (pinned Kickstart 3.0 worker) accepts at most 510 characters of argument text after the command name and redirections; longer lines fail with status 10 before the program runs.
link_command_line_limit.limitations: Limit measured only in this worker configuration; the 5.0a -f path is supported by ln strings but was not executed.
link_command_line_limit.ln_option: Aztec 3.6a and 5.0a ln both accept -f FILE (strings: Cannot have nested -f options; Too few arguments in -f file).
link_command_line_limit.symptom: reg-ov11_4790-5CEA natural-interval link (33 source objects): 580-character ln command, guest status 10, empty t000-ln.log, no executable (cache 94cbb29bb1e6..., worker job compile-d8d519375561)
link_command_line_limit.verification: Region rerun via compile queue: cache e653318e690d..., worker job compile-89766e447d1f, all guest steps 0, executable linked; verdict DIFFER (draft member sources).
